items.title: Vistra Is Still Down 17% This Year: Did Earnings Just Mark the Bottom?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVistra is down 17% in 2026 because Texas power prices stayed weak and Texas elected a governor who wants to pause new data centers. Constellation Energy has fallen even further this year, so part of the drop is a selloff across AI-power stocks, but Texas is Vistra’s own problem.

items.title: Energy Transition Update - Holu Hou Energy Revolutionizes MDU Solar Adoption
items.summary: Holu Hou Energy has launched the HoluPower 3.0, a solar energy storage system designed for its "EnergyCluster" platform, which targets multi-dwelling unit (MDU) housing.
